references.text: Balaam had Balak build seven altars and sacrifice a bull and a ram on each altar, which he now refers to in verse 4.
God also came to Balaam earlier and spoke with him, showing a pattern of divine communication with Balaam.
God came to Balaam at night and gave him instructions, another example of God speaking directly to Balaam.
Abraham presented seven lambs as a witness, illustrating the significance of the number seven in sacrificial contexts.
Job's friends were asked to sacrifice seven bulls and seven rams, demonstrating the use of seven animals in offerings to God.
King Hezekiah sacrificed seven bulls, seven rams, and seven lambs, reflecting the traditional pattern of seven sacrificial animals.
